title: Reverse Bits
summary: Reverse the order of the 32 bits of an unsigned integer.

tests.explain: 6 is 110 in its lowest bits, so 00…0110 reversed is 0110 0…0: bits 29 and 30 are set, which is 2^30 + 2^29 = 1610612736.
Bit 0 moves to bit 31: 2^31 = 2147483648. The answer must be unsigned, not -2147483648.
All 32 bits are 1, so reversing changes nothing.

hints: Treat n as exactly 32 bits, leading zeros included. Bit 0 must become bit 31, bit 1 becomes bit 30, and so on.
Loop 32 times: shift the result left by one, OR in n's lowest bit (n & 1), then shift n right by one.
In JavaScript, use n >>>= 1 (unsigned shift) so inputs of 2^31 and above work, and return result >>> 0 so a set top bit doesn't make the answer negative.
